description: Batch version of the Indian identifier validator: up to 50 values per call (GSTIN, PAN, TAN, CIN, LLPIN, IFSC, PIN code, UPI ID and vehicle registration numbers), mixed types allowed, one flat price. Returns one decoded result per item plus counts by type and validity. Use it for cleaning vendor lists, invoices or onboarding data. Batches containing Aadhaar-like numbers are rejected without charge. Price: $0.02 per call, paid with x402.

items.description: Identifiers as strings or {"value","type"} objects (PIN codes may be JSON numbers). Blank items are skipped; a batch where every item is blank is rejected (400, not charged).

type.description: Default type for all items. Force a type instead of auto-detection (default auto). Case-insensitive; one of: auto, gstin, pan, tan, cin, llpin, ifsc, pincode, upi, vehicle.

name: india_id_validate_batch
title: Validate up to 50 Indian identifiers
